title: A Atlas for the Uniform
author: Q. M. Villalobos
blurb: Noor Lockridge, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, has spent seven years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the century turns.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
